question: As per the Census of India 2011, a person aged ______ or above, who can both read and write with understanding in any language, is treated as literate.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the** 2001 Census**, a person is considered** literate** if they are** at least 7 years old** and** can write and read** in any language with comprehension.
 
• A person is **not literate** if they can just read and cannot write.
 
• Prior to **1991**, children **under the age of five** had to be considered** illiterate in censuses.**
 
• According to the **2001 Census**, **53.67% of females** and **75.26% of males** are **literate.**
 
• According to the** 2001 Census**,** 64.84 percent **of the population is** literate overall.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Census 2011:

 
 
• It is the 15th National Census Survey conducted by the Census Organization of India.
 
• Shri C. Chandramouli is the Commissioner and Registrar General of Census of India 2011.
 
• As per the Census of India 2011, the population density of India was 382 per square km.
 
• The Indian Census is the most credible source of information on Demography (Population characteristics), Economic Activity, Literacy and Education, Housing Household Amenities, Urbanisation, Fertility, Mortality, etc.
 
• Census was introduced in India during the era of Lord Mayo in the year 1872. It came into force in 1881.
 
• The slogan of census 2011 was 'Our Census, Our future'.
 
• The population of the nation as per the provisional figures of Census 2011 was 1210.19 million of which 623.7 million (51.54%) were males and 586.46 million (48.46%) were females. Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India its population is more than the population of Brazil.
